profile.role_note: Fusion Sword Main DPS or quickswap sub-DPS; Outro buffs Fusion DMG and Resonance Liberation DMG for the next Resonator.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Skip unless you specifically want her: an older limited 5-star Fusion DPS now outpaced by newer units, best used as a quickswap sub-DPS in mono-Fusion teams with Brant and Lupa.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Blazing Brilliance + 5-piece Molten Rift in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Inferno Rider (or Nightmare: Inferno Rider) in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Fusion DMG Bonus 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and prioritize Crit, Resonance Skill DMG Bonus, and Energy Regen in substats.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit DMG substat plus stacking Resonance Skill DMG and ATK% — best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner 5-star; Crit Rate substat and ATK buff on Resonance Skill cast. Free at Union Level 45.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star option; ATK boost after Intro Skill. Easy to obtain from all banners.

ranked_weapons.name: Lunar Cutter
ranked_weapons.note: Alternative 4-star; ATK stacks on entering the field. Good for quickswap play.

build.weapon_filler_note: Lumingloss (4-star) and Red Spring (5-star) are also listed as viable alternatives in community guides.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Fusion DMG bonus that further spikes for 15s after using Resonance Skill — perfect uptime given her rotation.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Support-flavored sub-DPS setup: Energy Regen and a big ATK buff for the incoming DPS via Outro.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Fusion DMG + ATK while farming a full 5-piece set.

stat_priorities.note: Fusion DMG on both pieces; Energy Regen on one is acceptable to smooth her Liberation cycle.
ATK% on both; her kit scales with ATK.

build.energy_regen_target: No community-agreed % target — sources only advise building more Energy Regen than typical DPS to cycle her Liberation smoothly.

teams.name: Premium: Changli + Brant + Lupa

members.name: Changli
members.note: Quickswap burst; Outro boosts Lupa's Fusion DMG and Resonance Liberation DMG.

members.name: Brant
members.note: Sustain plus Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG buffs; Outro feeds Changli's burst.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Pack Hunt grants the team ATK and Fusion DMG after her Liberation; anchors the rotation.

teams.rotation: Lupa opens and casts Liberation to activate Pack Hunt; Brant takes the field to build Concerto Energy, then Outro into Changli for the Resonance Skill DMG buff. Changli bursts through her Forte and Liberation, then Outros back to Lupa, whose empowered Liberation closes the loop.

teams.name: Budget: Changli + Encore + Verina

members.name: Changli
members.note: Quickswap support-DPS; her Outro massively boosts Encore's Fusion DMG.

members.name: Encore
members.note: The on-field carry; benefits from Changli's Fusion DMG and Liberation DMG buffs.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing and team ATK buffs via her Outro.

teams.rotation: Verina buffs and heals, then Outros into Changli for a quick Forte and Liberation burst; Changli Outros into Encore, who takes an extended on-field window with full buffs. Moonlit Clouds on Changli is preferred here.

teams.name: Alternative: Changli + Yinlin + Verina

members.name: Changli
members.note: Carries as the primary on-field DPS in this setup.

members.name: Yinlin
members.note: Coordinated attacks and Resonance Liberation DMG amplification via Outro.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Sustain plus ATK and damage buffs for Changli's burst window.

teams.rotation: Yinlin applies her marks and builds Concerto Energy, Verina refreshes buffs and heals, then Changli takes an extended field window: Resonance Skill into Forte stacks, enhanced Heavy Attack, Liberation, and a second enhanced Heavy Attack.

tier_badge.label: Strong
tier_badge.note: Solid Fusion sub-DPS and quickswap option; outpaced by newer DPS units but still viable with investment.
